task_description: Expand the auto-typing/input injection system into a fully modular multi-backend architecture with 12 backends total, BackendManager with failover, expanded BaseBackend interface, and updated UI/storage. Also commit all previously missed .agents/ files.

Shared resolveBackend.js correctly maps all 33 name variants. Review v1 found 7 issues (5 critical: command injection, failover dead, Unicode truncation, AHK injection, duplicate maps). All 5 critical issues fixed. Review v2 APPROVED with 3 non-blocking notes (AHK doubled braces in SendText, Electron silent no-op, interKeyDelay unvalidated).
